condition.narrative: Section I.A 2 (a) of Schedule 2 to the Financing Agreement: The Recipient shall maintain throughout implementation of theOperation, a program coordination office (“Program Coordination Office” or “PCO”) with a composition, mandate and resourcessatisfactory to the Association, including: (i) a Program director; (ii) eight (8) Program executives; (iii) a procurementspecialist; (iv) a financial management specialist; (v) an environmental and social management specialist; (vi) a monitoring andevaluation specialist; (vii) eight (8) change management facilitators, all with qualifications, experience and under terms ofreference satisfactory to the Association.Section I.C of Schedule 2 to the Financing Agreement: The Recipient shall: (1) not laterthan three (3) months after the Effective Date, recruit and thereafter maintain at all times during the implementation of theProgram, an Independent Verification Agent, under terms of reference acceptable to the Association; and (2) ensure that theIndependent Verification Agent prepares and provides verification reports certifying the achievement of the DLRs set out in SectionIV.A.2, in accordance with the Verification Protocol.

title.narrative: Improved women's skills and safety in filing taxes as a result of a separate help desk

comment.narrative:
The expected results of improved services for women in filing taxes will be measured by the number of hours reduced for tax filing by women.
GRA plans to (a) provide gender sensitive training to staff and (b) employ more women to interface with traders to ensure that staff relate well with the traders and taxpayers.

In this regard, The CAGD is moving forward with the signing of a memorandum of understanding with the Ghana Interbank Payment and Settlement System (GhIPSS), the Bank of Ghana, and the Association of Commercial Banks to promote the processing of transactions on GIFMIS and the use of electronic funds transfer to commercial banks

baseline.value: - New Tax Expenditure bill submitted to the Parliament. Current practices are not transparent. - No incentives for climate smart investments currently in place- Non-salaried active taxpayers are total 159,000

target.value: - Adopt data-driven, revised policy framework for conceptualizing, appraising, and approving new tax expenditures by Cabinet, based on the publication of repository of tax expenditures and the cost of these expenditures- 500 tax expenditure claims granted for clmate smart investments- 79,500 increase in the number of non-salaried active taxpayers

comment.narrative: The indicator measures the level of improvement in public resource mobilization through rationalized tax expenditures, incentives for climate smart investments, and expanded tax net.

actual.value: Tax Exemption Act (Act 1083) was passed in 2022 and administrative guidelines published in August 2023. A tax expenditures repository completed during the last quarter of 2023. The GoG granted 14 tax expenditure claims granted for climate smart investments and tax expenditures on imports for 2023 were published in the 2024 Annual Budget Statement. The GRA added 27,313 non- salaried tax payers to the register and deployed online platforms to allow tax payers to file and pay taxes.

comment.narrative:
The objective is to strengthen the oversight, performance management and fiscal discipline of SOEs.
The draft report for the 2024 SOR has been prepared and is currently undergoing review by the technical team. It will be submitted to management in early August 2025 for further review and then published by the end of August 2025.

actual.value: Annual State Ownership Report for 2023 was published in August 2024.

comment.narrative:
The objective is to strengthen the oversight, performance management and fiscal discipline of SOEs.
The 2024 State Ownership Report (SOR) was successfully published on time in August 2025.
The limited budgetary provision in the 2025 budget could not allow for the preparation of the reports hence this has been replanned for 2026. SIGA authorities informed the mission that the PCO and SIGA had discussed and concluded that the structure and criteria of the Annual Governance and Institutional Performance Assessment Report (AGIPAR), which is prepared annually as part of the mandate of SIGA, addresses the requirements of the CPER and could be used as a substitute. Public Investment and Assets Division of the MoF has revised the formula for the calculation of the net transfers to SOEs. Data is being collected based on the revised template from relevant institutions to ascertain the baseline and outturns for 2023 and 2024 and will be provided in the second quarter 2026

actual.value: Annual State Ownership Report for 2024 was published in August 2025.

comment.narrative: Tax to GDP ratio increased from the baseline of 12 percent (2022) to 13.6 percent at the end of 2024 as reported in the MoF Annual Tax Revenue Performance Report. This represents substantial progress from the baseline despite being lower than the earlier reported figure. The 13.6 percent figure is a revised GDP figure.

comment.narrative: GRA is on-boarding taxpayers onto the e-VAT scheme. The target is to onboard at least 2650 taxpayers. GRA is now implementing the modified taxation for the informal sector through presumptive taxes for traders below the VAT registration threshold. In addition, a Special Voluntary Disclosure Program to encourage voluntary disclosure of assets and income earned outside Ghana by Ghanaian residents by taxpayers was instituted.

title.narrative: PFM reforms implementation is effectively led through an adequate governance structure and an effective change management approach

baseline.value: - No regular progress reporting was done on the last PFM strategy- There are no change management facilitators and change management is lacking. - No framework for PFM research exists and research papers have not been completed.

target.value: - Two (2) semi-annual PFM Strategy implementation progress reports and one (1) change management facilitators evaluation report are prepared and discussed in stakeholders workshops in a given fiscal year- Ten (10) research papers on PFM reform lessons published

comment.narrative:
The objective is to implement an effective change management approach and governance structure for PFM reform implementation.
The PCO prepared a Semi-Annual Public Financial Management Strategy Implementation Progress Report for the period from January 2024 to June 2025.
The OHCS will leverage its own experience and promote management tools and approaches across ministries and agencies.

actual.value: One (1) semi-annual PFM Strategy implementation progress report and two (2) draft PFM Strategy Semi-Annual and Annual Report prepared. The Bank received the final 2024 Semi-Annual PFM Strategy implementation report.
